subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: per-gateway custom headers for gateways behind authenticating proxies

question: Should the mobile apps support arbitrary per-gateway HTTP headers for Gateway upgrades, or should the approved contract be narrowed to typed proxy-auth credentials before the platform PRs land?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this feature stores and replays credentials before normal Gateway auth, which is a product/security boundary rather than a routine bug fix.

options.title: Approve arbitrary headers with gates
options.body: Proceed with the per-gateway name/value model only after owner/security review accepts the sanitizer, secure-store lifecycle, diagnostics redaction, TLS behavior, and non-gateway isolation on both platforms.

options.title: Narrow to typed proxy auth
options.body: Revise the direction to Basic/Bearer/fixed-header credentials so mobile can validate, redact, clear, and document a smaller credential surface.

options.title: Defer native proxy credentials
options.body: Keep mobile reverse-proxy credential injection unsupported until the broader CLI/mobile transport-auth design is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve arbitrary headers with gates
recommendation.body: Proceed with the per-gateway name/value model only after owner/security review accepts the sanitizer, secure-store lifecycle, diagnostics redaction, TLS behavior, and non-gateway isolation on both platforms.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the canonical issue and both platform PRs and has the strongest recent signal on the mobile Gateway auth/product boundary.
